# HANAKO-WP PROJECT OVERVIEW FOR LLMs

## Project Summary
hanako-wp is a modern WordPress theme built with:
- **Templating**: Timber (PHP) + Twig for views
- **CSS Framework**: Tailwind CSS (v4) with custom Bootstrap breakpoints
- **JavaScript Framework**: Hanako-TS (NOT jQuery - see GitHub: https://github.com/harkle/hanako-ts)
- **Build Tool**: Vite v7
- **Language**: TypeScript for component logic

## CRITICAL: No jQuery - Use Hanako-TS Instead

⚠️ **IMPORTANT**: The `$` symbol NEVER refers to jQuery in this project.
- jQuery is NOT installed or used anywhere.
- `$` refers exclusively to hanako-ts framework components and utilities.
- All DOM manipulation uses hanako-ts
- See: https://github.com/harkle/hanako-ts for framework documentation

## Architecture Overview

### 1. Directory Structure
```
hanako-wp-2/
├── views/
│   ├── twig/                    # Twig templates
│   │   ├── components/          # Co-located interactive components (TS + CSS + Twig)
│   │   │   ├── Carousel/        # Image carousel with smooth transitions
│   │   │   ├── Collapse/        # Collapsible panels + accordion system
│   │   │   ├── Dropdown/        # Dropdown menus with ESC support
│   │   │   ├── Modal/           # Reusable modal dialogs
│   │   │   ├── CookiesConsent/  # GDPR consent banner using Modal
│   │   │   ├── DarkMode/        # Theme switcher (light/dark/auto)
│   │   │   ├── Header/          # Site header with navigation
│   │   │   ├── Footer/          # Site footer
│   │   │   └── Menu/            # Main navigation menu
│   │   ├── pages/               # Page templates (404, front-page, page, single-post, archive-post)
│   │   ├── modules/             # Reusable template modules (demo, videos, etc.)
│   │   └── structure/           # Layout structure (html.twig)
│   ├── ts/                      # TypeScript utilities
│   │   ├── script.ts            # Main entry point - component initialization
│   │   └── components/          # Utility components (Analytics, LazyLoader, ScrollSpy)
│   └── scss/                    # CSS files (not SCSS - plain CSS despite folder name)
│       ├── config/              # Modular design system variables
│       │   ├── _colors.css      # Color palette (customizable)
│       │   ├── _typography.css  # Font scales and heading styles
│       │   └── _spacing.css     # Spacing, shadows, transitions, border radius
│       ├── style.css            # Main stylesheet
│       ├── editor-style.css     # WordPress editor styles
│       └── [component files]    # Component-specific CSS
├── tailwind.config.ts           # Tailwind configuration with custom breakpoints
├── vite.config.ts               # Vite build configuration
├── postcss.config.js            # PostCSS configuration
└── dist/                        # Built output (auto-generated)
```

### 2. Component Architecture

All interactive components follow the same pattern:
- **Location**: `views/twig/components/{ComponentName}/`
- **Files**:
  - `index.ts` - Component class extending hanako-ts Component
  - `index.twig` - HTML structure
  - `index.css` - Component styling

Example structure (Carousel component):
```
views/twig/components/Carousel/
├── index.ts      # Class Carousel extends Component { init() {...} }
├── index.twig    # <div class="hw-carousel" data-hw-carousel>...</div>
└── index.css     # .hw-carousel { ... } styling
```

### 3. Component Naming Convention

All components use `hw-` prefix with BEM element syntax using `__` (double underscore):
- `.hw-carousel` - Component root
- `.hw-carousel__inner` - Child element
- `.hw-carousel__item` - List item element
- `.hw-carousel__item.is-active` - State modifier

Data attributes follow the same pattern:
- `data-hw-carousel` - Main component trigger
- `data-hw-carousel-to="0"` - Carousel slide selector
- `data-hw-carousel-prev` - Previous slide button
- `data-hw-collapse-target="#elementId"` - Collapse target
- `data-hw-dropdown-toggle` - Dropdown toggle

### 4. Tailwind CSS Configuration

#### Custom Breakpoints (Bootstrap parity)
```
xs:   0px      (default)
sm:   576px    (phones landscape)
md:   768px    (tablets)
lg:   992px    (laptops)
xl:   1200px   (desktops)
xxl:  1400px   (large screens)
```

#### Container System
- Use `.container` class on wrapper divs
- Automatically handles max-width and padding
- Replaces old manual `mx-auto w-full max-w-[1200px] px-4` hack

#### Grid Layout
- Use native Tailwind grid classes with 12-column system:
```html
<div class="grid grid-cols-12 gap-6">
  <div class="col-span-12 lg:col-span-3"><!-- 1/4 width on large screens --></div>
  <div class="col-span-12 lg:col-span-9"><!-- 3/4 width on large screens --></div>
</div>
```

### 5. Maximizing Utility Classes (Critical Principle)

This project prioritizes Tailwind utility classes over custom CSS:

**✅ GOOD - Use utilities:**
```html
<div class="flex items-center justify-between p-4 mb-6 bg-white rounded-lg shadow">
  <h2 class="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900">Title</h2>
</div>
```

**❌ AVOID - Creating custom classes for this:**
```css
.card {
  @apply flex items-center justify-between p-4 mb-6 bg-white rounded-lg shadow;
}
```

**✅ GOOD - Use @apply in components only:**
Component styling should use @apply when needed:
```css
.hw-carousel {
  @apply relative rounded-lg overflow-hidden bg-black;
}

.hw-carousel__item.is-active {
  @apply opacity-100 transform-none;
}
```

### 6. Component Lifecycle

Components in hanako-ts follow this pattern:

```typescript
import { Component } from 'hanako-ts/dist-legacy/Component';

export class MyComponent extends Component {
  constructor(isDebugEnabled: boolean = false) {
    super('MyComponent', isDebugEnabled);
  }

  public async init(): Promise<void> {
    await super.init();

    // DOM initialization
    // Event listener setup
    // State management

    this.success(); // Log successful initialization
  }

  // Private methods for logic
  private handleClick(): void {
    // ...
  }
}
```

Key points:
- Extends `hanako-ts/dist-legacy/Component`
- `init()` is called automatically from `views/ts/script.ts`
- Use `this.success()` to signal successful initialization
- All DOM queries use vanilla JavaScript (no jQuery)

### 7. Main Components

#### Carousel
- Location: `views/twig/components/Carousel/`
- Features: Slide transitions, indicators, prev/next controls
- Classes: `.hw-carousel`, `.hw-carousel__item`, `.hw-carousel__indicators`
- Data: `data-hw-carousel`, `data-hw-carousel-to`, `data-hw-carousel-prev/next`

#### Collapse
- Location: `views/twig/components/Collapse/`
- Features: Height-animated collapsible panels, accordion support
- Classes: `.hw-collapse__panel`, `.hw-accordion`, `.hw-accordion__button`
- Data: `data-hw-collapse-target`, `data-hw-collapse-group`
- CSS: Smooth height transition using `requestAnimationFrame`

#### Modal
- Location: `views/twig/components/Modal/`
- Features: Reusable modal with ESC key support, backdrop click handling
- Classes: `.hw-modal`, `.hw-modal__dialog`, `.hw-modal__content`
- Data: `data-hw-modal-close`
- Used by: CookiesConsent component

#### Dropdown
- Location: `views/twig/components/Dropdown/`
- Features: Toggle menus with outside-click closure
- Data: `data-hw-dropdown-toggle`, `data-hw-dropdown-menu`, `data-hw-dropdown-close`
- ESC key support for all dropdowns

#### DarkMode
- Location: `views/twig/components/DarkMode/`
- Features: Light/dark/auto theme switching
- Stores preference in localStorage
- Uses HTML `color-scheme` attribute

#### CookiesConsent
- Location: `views/twig/components/CookiesConsent/`
- Features: GDPR consent banner with settings modal
- Instantiates Modal component for settings dialog
- Manages cookie categories via JavaScript events

### 8. CSS Structure

#### Main Stylesheet Flow (views/scss/style.css)
1. Config imports (colors, typography, spacing)
2. Tailwind directives (@import "tailwindcss")
3. Typography fonts and base styles
4. Structure utilities (hw-ratio, hw-img-fluid)
5. Lazy loader styles
6. Icon system
7. Component styles (imported from _modules.css)

#### _modules.css
Central import point for all component CSS files:
```css
@import '../twig/components/Carousel/index.css';
@import '../twig/components/Collapse/index.css';
@import '../twig/components/Modal/index.css';
/* ... etc */
```

#### CSS Variables (Design System)
Available in `:root`:
- Colors: `--color-primary`, `--color-secondary`, `--color-danger`, `--color-text`, etc.
- Typography: `--font-weight-*`, `--font-size-*`, `--line-height-*`
- Spacing: `--spacing-*`, `--radius-*`, `--shadow-*`, `--duration-*`

### 9. Build Pipeline

**Development**: `npm run dev`
- Vite watch mode
- Auto-reload on file changes
- Source maps enabled

**Production**: `npm run build`
- Minified CSS/JS output
- Asset hashing for cache busting
- Manifest file for WordPress asset versioning
- Output: `dist/` folder

**Linting**:
- `npm run lint:ts` - TypeScript linting (ESLint)
- `npm run lint:css` - CSS linting (Stylelint)
- `npm run format` - Code formatting (Prettier)

### 10. Asset Management

Vite output structure:
```
dist/
├── css/
│   ├── style-[hash].css
│   └── editor-style-[hash].css
├── js/
│   └── script-[hash].js
├── assets/
│   ├── icons/
│   └── images/
└── .vite/manifest.json
```

WordPress PHP integration uses manifest.json for asset versioning:
- No hardcoded hashes in PHP
- Automatic cache busting on every build
- See `functions.php` for asset enqueueing

### 11. Important Rules for Development

1. **Always use `.container`** for layout wrappers (replaces manual max-width)
2. **Use grid grid-cols-12** for multi-column layouts (replaces `.row`)
3. **No jQuery** - Use hanako-ts Component class or vanilla DOM APIs
4. **Maximize utility classes** - Avoid creating custom CSS when Tailwind utilities exist
5. **BEM naming with `__`** for component CSS (double underscore for elements)
6. **Co-locate component files** - Keep TS, CSS, and Twig in same folder
7. **Responsive prefixes** - Use Tailwind breakpoints (lg:, xl:, etc.)
8. **No Bootstrap** - All Bootstrap dependencies removed; use Tailwind equivalents

### 12. Hanako-TS Framework Reference

**Repository**: https://github.com/harkle/hanako-ts

The hanako-ts framework provides:
- `Component` base class for all interactive components
- Automatic component initialization system
- DOM querying helpers
- Debug logging capabilities
- TypeScript support out of the box

When you see components extending `Component` in this project, they're using hanako-ts, NOT jQuery.

## Common Development Workflows

### Adding a New Component
1. Create folder: `views/twig/components/MyComponent/`
2. Create three files:
   - `index.ts` - Component class
   - `index.twig` - HTML structure
   - `index.css` - Styling with `.hw-mycomponent` prefix
3. Import in `views/ts/script.ts`
4. Initialize: `(new MyComponent()).init();`

### Styling with Utilities
```html
<!-- ✅ Maximize utilities -->
<button class="px-4 py-2 rounded-md bg-blue-600 text-white hover:bg-blue-700 transition-colors">
  Click me
</button>

<!-- In component CSS, use @apply sparingly -->
.hw-button-primary {
  @apply px-4 py-2 rounded-md bg-blue-600 text-white;
}

.hw-button-primary:hover {
  @apply bg-blue-700;
}
```

### Customizing Design System
Edit these files to change the design:
- Colors: `views/scss/config/_colors.css`
- Typography: `views/scss/config/_typography.css`
- Spacing: `views/scss/config/_spacing.css`

All changes automatically available via CSS variables throughout the site.

## Build Information
- **Last Build**: Check dist/ folder date
- **CSS Size**: ~6KB gzipped (optimized with Tailwind)
- **JS Size**: ~6.5KB gzipped (component code only)
- **Asset Versioning**: Manifest.json handles cache busting

## Performance Considerations
- Lazy loading for images (LazyLoader component)
- Smooth animations using CSS transitions and requestAnimationFrame
- No unnecessary external libraries
- Tailwind CSS purges unused utilities
- Minimal JavaScript payload (core components only)

## Debugging Tips
1. Check `views/ts/script.ts` to see component initialization order
2. Components log status with `this.success()` - check console
3. Use `data-debug` attribute in hanako-ts to enable verbose logging
4. CSS utilities are from Tailwind - reference https://tailwindcss.com/docs/utility-first
5. For TypeScript errors, check `tsconfig.json`
